package store

import (
	"os"
	"testing"
)

func TestReadRollbackDatabase(t *testing.T) {
	s, err := Open(t.Context(), os.Getenv("OBERTH_ROLLBACK_DATABASE"), testOptions())
	requireOK(t, err)
	defer func() { requireOK(t, s.Close()) }()
	run, err := s.Run(t.Context(), "schema-six-run")
	requireOK(t, err)
	if run.Repo != "origin/team/repo" || !run.HasAdmission {
		t.Fatal("main lost the accepted run")
	}
	for _, id := range []int64{50, 90} {
		issue, err := s.Issue(t.Context(), id)
		requireOK(t, err)
		if issue.Title != "Schema six issue" {
			t.Fatal("main lost an issue", id)
		}
	}
}
